errors.keptParamInTemplate: The {{key}} row keeps {{name}}, which its URL already sets
errors.sharedCaseMark: The {{key}} row marks the case of {{name}}, which shares a part of its URL with another value
errors.ampersandEntityName: The {{key}} row sets {{name}}, which the ampersand mark reads as another parameter
errors.statefulCheckRegex: The check of {{name}} is a pattern with a g or y flag, which answers differently on a second call
errors.unanchoredCheckRegex: The check of {{name}} is a pattern without ^ at its start and $ at its end
errors.misplacedOpenTail: The {{key}} row writes {*} elsewhere than at the end of its path, behind a slash
errors.openTailBesideMultiSegment: The {{key}} row writes {*} in a path with {{name}}, which takes several segments, so the two are split by a guess
errors.openTailName: The {{key}} row names a value tail, which {*} is read as
errors.feedFallThrough: The {{platform}} feed table sets isFallThrough, which only a page table takes
